below. Try light and dark modes, then select the presenter view to read the notes.
Use the [syntax reference](syntax-reference.md) to look up settings and syntax.

The [feature tour](example.qmd) covers importance, synchronized code and math,
matched colors, footnotes and notes. The [picture patterns](patterns.qmd) cover
statements, quotations, credits, full-slide images and ordinary left/right pictures.

## Use the example in your deck

[Install the htmpres extension](quarto-extension.md) in a new project folder.
Then save the complete example there:

1. Save the [complete Markdown](_generated/source/syntax.qmd.txt) as `index.qmd`.
2. Save the [example stylesheet](_generated/source/syntax.css.txt) as `source.css` beside it.
3. Put the supplied assets in the deck's `assets/` folder.
4. [Render and preview the deck](authoring-cli.md#human-commands).

To copy one slide into an existing deck, keep its required assets and CSS rules.
The custom classes and their rules are listed in the downloaded `source.css`;
bundled classes start with `ds-` or appear in the [starter styles](syntax-reference.md#starter-styles).
If the slide links to another slide, copy that destination or update the link.
Replace sample content and descriptions before you present.

The stylesheet defines the custom example classes that appear in the source.
Bundled classes such as `.ds-alpha` work without those rules. For a different
opacity, add a class to your image and define its value in CSS:

```markdown
![A geometric texture](assets/texture.svg){.ds-fit .ds-alpha .faint-image}
```

```css
.faint-image { --ds-opacity: .25; }
```

Other example rules set the comparison grid's dimensions and the custom filter
and zoom values. Download the stylesheet to copy every rule with its class.

| Asset | Use |
| --- | --- |
| [Texture](_generated/source/syntax-assets/texture.svg) | Backgrounds, crops and filters |
| [Diagram](_generated/source/syntax-assets/two-views.svg) | Fit/fill and split panes |
| [Transparent rings](_generated/source/syntax-assets/transparent-rings.svg) | Intrinsic transparency |
| [Video](_generated/source/syntax-assets/motion.mp4) and [captions](_generated/source/syntax-assets/motion.vtt) | Four-second playback example |
| [Audio](_generated/source/syntax-assets/tone.wav) | Quiet one-second tone |
| [Embedded page](_generated/source/syntax-assets/embedded.html) | Local interactive counter |

All assets are original examples supplied by htmpres authors. They work offline.
The video is silent. Audio starts only when you select Play.

Open the full deck for ordinary navigation, counters, autoplay and automatic
advance after playback. The embedded preview keeps keyboard navigation on the
selected slide and pauses automatic playback while you inspect its Markdown.
Select Play to start audio or video. Full decks retain the authored autoplay
behavior, subject to browser policy.
